title: What plumbers do
d: Plumbers install and repair the pipes, fixtures, and systems that bring clean water in and take waste out. It is a licensed trade in most places, learned throug
description: Plumbers install and repair the pipes, fixtures, and systems that bring clean water in and take waste out. It is a licensed trade in most places, learned through 4-5 year apprenticeships combining paid work with classroom hours. Demand is steady — every building has plumbing, and it always needs maintenance.

title: Essential tools
d: Two pipe wrenches (one to hold, one to turn), adjustable wrench, tubing cutter, plunger, drain snake, basin wrench, Teflon tape, plumber's putty, torch and sold
description: Two pipe wrenches (one to hold, one to turn), adjustable wrench, tubing cutter, plunger, drain snake, basin wrench, Teflon tape, plumber's putty, torch and solder for copper, and a bright flashlight. Pros add: press-fit tool, inspection camera, and a pipe freezer kit.

title: Key skills
d: Reading blueprints and isometric drawings, soldering copper, solvent-welding PVC/ABS/CPVC, threading steel pipe, diagnosing pressure and drainage problems, and
description: Reading blueprints and isometric drawings, soldering copper, solvent-welding PVC/ABS/CPVC, threading steel pipe, diagnosing pressure and drainage problems, and sequencing rough-in before finish work. Plus: clear communication and spotless cleanup.

title: Safety essentials
d: Know the main water shutoff before starting any job. Eye protection for soldering and cutting; ventilate solvents and flux; never test for gas with a flame; lif
description: Know the main water shutoff before starting any job. Eye protection for soldering and cutting; ventilate solvents and flux; never test for gas with a flame; lift with your legs — cast iron and water heaters are brutal.

title: Getting started
d: Finish high school (math helps), find a union or non-union apprenticeship, get an apprentice license, log roughly 8,000 hours over 4-5 years, then pass the jour
description: Finish high school (math helps), find a union or non-union apprenticeship, get an apprentice license, log roughly 8,000 hours over 4-5 years, then pass the journeyman exam. Many start as helpers to learn the ropes.

title: Pro tips
d: Photograph everything before disassembly. Keep an organizer of common washers, O-rings, and cartridges. Quote flat-rate for routine jobs. Always test at full pr
description: Photograph everything before disassembly. Keep an organizer of common washers, O-rings, and cartridges. Quote flat-rate for routine jobs. Always test at full pressure before leaving — and leave the space cleaner than you found it.
